import sys, json, os, subprocess, time, random, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
from t_common import *
import scamp_pipeline as sp
rng = random.Random(20240)

lines = []
# 4 big compiles (sum fib = 8192)
for k in range(4):
    fib = gen_fib(rng, 2048, rng.choice(['mixed','long','aligned']))
    S = rng.choice([4,8,16]); ms = rng.choice([8,16,32])
    if S*ms < 128: S = 16; ms = 32
    lines.append(json.dumps({'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':sp.canon_prefix(a,l),'hop':h} for (a,l,h) in fib],
        'capacities':[10**9]*S,'max_stride':ms},separators=(',',':')))
# compile the images we will query
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input='\n'.join(lines[:2])+'\n', text=True, capture_output=True)
imgs = [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.split('\n')[:-1]]
assert all(i['status']=='ok' for i in imgs)
# 4 big lookups (sum image fib 8192, sum addresses 50000)
per = 50000//4
for k,img in enumerate(imgs*2):
    addrs = [sp.canon_addr(rng.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(per//2)]
    lines.append(json.dumps({'op':'lookup','image':img,'addresses':addrs},separators=(',',':')))
# many small requests + malformed lines
for k in range(190):
    t = k % 5
    if t == 0:
        lines.append(json.dumps({'op':'compile','fib':[],'capacities':[10**9]*4,'max_stride':32},separators=(',',':')))
    elif t == 1:
        lines.append('{bad json')
    elif t == 2:
        lines.append(json.dumps({'op':'lookup','image':imgs[0],'addresses':[]},separators=(',',':')))
    elif t == 3:
        lines.append('['*5000)
    else:
        lines.append(json.dumps({'op':'nope'},separators=(',',':')))
data = ''.join(x+'\n' for x in lines)
print('total input %.2f MiB, %d requests' % (len(data)/1048576.0, len(lines)))
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=data.encode(), capture_output=True, timeout=900)
dt=time.time()-t0
rss = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss/1024.0
out = p.stdout.split(b'\n'); assert out[-1]==b''; out=out[:-1]
print('rc=%d time=%.2fs peakrss=%.0fMiB responses=%d' % (p.returncode, dt, rss, len(out)))
assert p.returncode==0 and len(out)==len(lines)
big = max(len(x) for x in out)
print('largest response %.2f MiB' % (big/1048576.0))
st = {}
for o in out:
    r=json.loads(o); st[r['status']]=st.get(r['status'],0)+1
print(st)
print('stderr len', len(p.stderr))
EOF
